claim: Onboarding OB-3 (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 row OB-3, §4 F3, §5 I15): the verification mail carries a six-digit `verify_email` code beside its link, and sign-up says whether the mail left. SignInCodesService's CodePurpose includes verify_email (same HMAC, ten minutes, single use, five tries, shared per-address limits); migration sign_in_codes_carry_verify_email widens sign_in_codes_purpose_check to admit it. AuthService.registerAccount awaits queueEmailVerification and returns `{ ...tokens, verificationMail }`, where queueEmailVerification returns 'not_sent' on a refused or thrown send (it was fire-and-forget, only logged); a failed send never fails sign-up. The mail is verifyEmailTemplate (ADR 0174 paper sheet, no #7c2d12 banner), and POST /auth/verify-email takes `{ code }` from a signed-in person via AuthService.verifyEmailWithCode, checked against the account's own address. Behavioural proof: apps/api-gateway/src/auth/verify-email-code.spec.ts (t1-t5), which fails on origin/main c93d6115c and passes on fix/verify-mail-carries-a-code.
